subject: P0 REGRESSION from 372: box flag delivery is broken for visitors with no session
description:
CAUSED BY MY OWN 372 CHANGE TODAY (063880a1f, deployed 2026-09-09T07:28Z). BoxEngine.requestFlagText (BoxEngine.js:1347) gates on 'typeof FirebaseAuth !== undefined && FirebaseAuth.isSignedIn()' and returns null when false, logging '[ARENA] Cannot deliver flag - no auth or registryId'. Before 372, _app/arena/firebase-init.js signed every visitor in anonymously on DOMContentLoaded, so isSignedIn() was TRUE on box pages and flags were delivered. 372 removed that load-time sign-in (correctly - it was minting ~45 accounts/day from crawler traffic) but NOTHING was wired to ArenaFirebase.ensureAuth(), which 372 added and left with ZERO callers. Nancy flagged the no-caller fact during that review; neither of us connected it to flag delivery. PROVEN ON PRODUCTION 2026-09-09 with a two-arm browser probe against /arena/boxes/nt1-network-troubleshoot/: arm 'no-signin' -> flag delivered NO, NT1Config.flags[0].value null, 1 UNCAUGHT TypeError 'Cannot read properties of null (reading toLowerCase)' at BoxEngine._hashFlag (BoxEngine.js:1257, which does value.toLowerCase() with no null guard); arm 'with-signin' (FirebaseAuth.signInAnonymously() then reload) -> flag delivered YES, value a string, 0 uncaught errors. SCOPE IS NOT NT1: this is BoxEngine, shared by every box with a server-delivered flag. FIX DIRECTION: await ArenaFirebase.ensureAuth() inside requestFlagText when !hasAuth, which is exactly the 'sign in only when an operation needs a uid' design 372 described but never wired; PLUS a null guard in _hashFlag so a failed delivery degrades instead of throwing. Minting a session when a student actually opens a box is the intended behaviour and does not reopen 372 (that was about load-time minting on 274 pages by drive-by traffic). NEEDS: four-way vote, a two-arm harness, and a check of whether flags a student ALREADY earned are affected.
[2026-09-09 20:24] PROVEN STUDENT IMPACT 2026-09-09 via _tools/hexos/nt1-completable-as-user.test.js against production, which harvests the flag from its rendered location and submits it through the real modal rather than reading engine state. SIGNED-IN arm: 27 passed / 0 failed -- all five NT1 scenarios completable, flag visible and ACCEPTED. NO-SESSION arm: 17 passed / 5 failed -- the fault is repairable and connectivity is restored in every scenario, but the flag NEVER APPEARS at any documented location, so ZERO of five are completable. A visitor without a session cannot finish any NT1 scenario. This is BoxEngine, not NT1: every box with a server-delivered flag is affected. Reproduce: node _tools/hexos/nt1-completable-as-user.test.js --no-signin
